description: The coverage advisor (spec 006, FR-015, FR-015a). Explains gaps the platform already detected; detects nothing, drafts nothing, decides nothing.

guardrail.note: Applied by the runtime as Converse's guardrailConfig, from the guardrail id and version infra sets in the environment. Principle II names guardrails as part of the GenAI layer.

tools.name: coverage-read
tools.description: Read-only inventory and rule lookups through the platform HTTP API. Every operation is a GET; the agent principal is refused on every other method (FR-056, R-602). Under AgentCore these are Converse tool calls served inside the runtime by agents/runtime/main.py; the allowlist module is unchanged..

info.title: Coverage advisor reads
info.description: One operation, and no coverage-proposal endpoint. The advisor cannot read the proposal list, so it cannot learn which gaps an admin has already rejected and cannot argue with that decision; deduplication against decided types is the platform's job (FR-018), performed before this agent is called. No /rules read either: rules apply to every resource, so they are never the fix for one type's coverage and the advisor has no reason to see them.

get.description: Use this to see what a resource type actually looks like in this tenant before describing a gap in it — which regions it appears in, which tags it already carries. The gap list itself is supplied in the prompt; this endpoint returning other types does not add them to it.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Narrow to one service, so a single call answers a single gap.

200.description: Resources with their type, region and tags.
